skill.name: after-effects-playbooks
skill.description: Use when the user asks what Manus can do with After Effects or needs an existing After Effects project or template customized, localized, versioned, rendered, collected, or prepared for handoff. Routes each workflow by retained state among Manus file and data preparation, reproduced After Effects automation or rendering routes, and After Effects through Computer Use for visual or project-state work.
skill.userDescription: Customize, render, package, and hand off After Effects projects.
exampleQuestions: Customize my After Effects template for a bilingual product launch.
Prepare this After Effects project for client handoff.
Help me plan a render and delivery workflow in After Effects.
